page.title: Fly Hook Size Chart
page.content:
Fly hooks are sized by number. From 1 to 24, the bigger the number, the smaller the hook: a size 20 midge hook is a fraction of the length of a size 2 streamer hook. Above size 1 the scale turns around and climbs as 1/0, 2/0 and up to 6/0, which are the big hooks for pike, muskie and saltwater flies.

Sizes go up in even numbers for most flies (12, 14, 16), and a pattern usually comes in four to seven of them. Long-shank streamer and nymph hooks are longer than the standard hooks drawn here, so a size 8 streamer looks bigger than a size 8 dry fly. When in doubt, match the size of the insect or baitfish you see, then go one size smaller if fish refuse.
